0_0.name: Entrance
0_0.description: A gloomy roof sits above a dark, dilapidated door made of wood. The wood is mushy and wet, most likely due to the fact that it has stormy outside. A cat sits at the entrance, eager to join you.

1_0.name: Hallway
1_0.description: A hallway which has shown signs of aging, with cobwebs hanging in the corners. No one has maintained this place in a long time.

2_0.name: Main Hall
2_0.description: The main area of the house- or so it was once. A place a laughter and congregation now lies silent and dormant.

3_0.name: Metal wall
3_0.description: At the other side of the door is a completely solid metal wall. Faint creaking can be heard in the distance. It is unknown why this would ever be added to such a location.

0_1.name: Apple tree courtyard
0_1.description: You feel as if you were once here- that is, in another time. There are no apples to be had here. Nor no flowers to be plucked. A small golden key sits on the ground, caked in mud.

1_1.name: The trash room
1_1.description: A large chute stands in the center, with incredibly old trash bags sitting in heaping piles around it. You would not dare go down that chute if your life depended on it.

2_1.name: The void
2_1.description: This room is completely white. The floors, ceiling, and walls are so bright that you must rely on touch to navigate around the room. While moving through it, you swear you felt something crawling on your hand.

3_1.name: A generic room
3_1.description: Out of all the places in this absurd environment, this room is pristine. A single figure stands in the center, but they don't seem to notice you, nor pay any mind.

0_2.name: Kitchen
0_2.description: No one has cooked in this kitchen for years. It smells like burnt ash. Bones lie on the floor. Somehow, every food remaining has molded over.

1_2.name: Pantry
1_2.description: There should be food stored here, but there doesn't appear to be anything of interest besides that of a hammer. Perhaps you could use this to take down some boards?

2_2.name: Bedrooms
2_2.description: Stacks upon stacks of beds which can only imply that everyone in this place slept in the same area. The beds tower up to absurd levels of height.

3_2.name: Cellar
3_2.description: You somehow found yourself in the cellar. The cobwebs down here have grown to undistinguishable levels. You dare not travel any further down.

0_3.name: The study room
0_3.description: A single chair with a desk sits in the very center of the room. A single lightbulb shines directly over it. The lightbulb hangs on a small thin string that swings back and forth.

3_3.name: Exit
3_3.description: You reach the exit. A wave of relief fills your soul. Whatever remained in that house will be long behind you.
